Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE production game texture atlas containing 20 vehicle photographs in a strict 5 columns by 4 rows uniform grid. Generate at 3840x2160 landscape if possible. Every cell has the SAME dimensions and complete rectangular photographic background, with a thin clean white grid divider. No captions, lettering, labels, watermarks or text. Each cell is a separate accurate photorealistic car photograph in beautiful central Moscow streets, elegant stone embankment, landscaped contemporary avenue with recognisable distant Moscow City skyline. No garages, no showroom. Natural bright overcast daylight, professional automotive editorial photo. For easy paint customization ALL cars have factory neutral SILVER paint, stock wheels, stock body, untinted blue-grey windows. Consistent front-left three-quarter view, nose pointing LEFT and nearer camera, passenger side extending RIGHT. Entire car including both wheels fits INSIDE central 80% of cell with generous margins; no cropping, no shared car between cells. Cars occupy about 75% cell width. Row-major exact models:
Row1: 2019 Toyota Raize; 2022 Toyota Yaris Cross; 2022 Toyota Corolla Cross; 2019 Toyota Vellfire; 2019 Toyota Noah.
Row2: 2019 Toyota Voxy; 2019 Toyota Harrier; 2019 Toyota Sienta; 2019 Nissan Serena; 2019 Nissan Kicks.
Row3: 2022 Nissan Ariya; 2022 Honda ZR-V; 2019 Honda Freed; 2023 Acura Integra liftback; 2019 Lexus NX 300h.
Row4: 2019 Lexus UX 250h; 2022 Lexus LM first generation; 2022 BMW i4; 2022 BMW iX; 2022 Audi Q4 e-tron.
Critical: accurate distinct factory model shapes and front ends; EXACTLY 5 columns and 4 rows, equal-size cells. SILVER body on EVERY vehicle. Wheels and road uncut. Individual backgrounds subdued neutral Moscow architecture.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE production game texture atlas of 18 vehicle photographs plus two empty background cells in a strict 5 columns by 4 rows uniform grid. Generate at 3840x2160 landscape if possible. Equal rectangular cells, thin clean WHITE grid dividers. No captions, labels, lettering or watermark. Photorealistic model-specific car photographs in attractive central Moscow, landscaped embankment streets, stylish stone buildings and distant Moscow City towers, bright natural soft daylight. No garage, no showroom. ALL vehicles in neutral factory SILVER paint, STOCK wheels, STOCK factory body, clear untinted blue-grey windows. Every shot front-left three-quarter view with nose LEFT nearest camera, body extends RIGHT; complete vehicle inside central 80% of each cell with space around wheels and bumper, no cropping. Row-major EXACT sequence:
Row1: 2019 Audi Q8; 2019 Mercedes-Benz GLB; 2022 Mercedes-Benz EQB; 2022 Hyundai Staria; 2024 Hyundai Casper Electric.
Row2: 2022 Hyundai Ioniq 5; 2019 Kia Carnival third generation; 2022 Kia EV6; 2019 Kia Seltos; 2019 Genesis G70.
Row3: 2019 Genesis G90 first generation; Volkswagen ID.4 first generation; 2019 Mazda CX-30; 2022 Mazda CX-60; 2023 Subaru Crosstrek.
Row4: Porsche Taycan first generation; 2019 Tesla Model 3 pre-facelift; 2022 Tesla Model Y; empty Moscow street background; empty Moscow street background.
Critical exact 5x4 grid uniform cells. Distinct accurate model grille/headlight shapes and silhouettes. Silver painted cars, not drawings.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE game texture atlas, 12 photorealistic photographs of legendary enthusiast cars, strict 4 columns by 3 rows grid of equal rectangular cells, thin white straight grid lines. 3840x2160 landscape if possible. No text, no labels or watermarks. Beautiful Moscow urban photography on elegant embankment and leafy stone avenues with distant Moscow City skyline. Silver factory body paint on ALL 12 cars, standard factory wheels, NO aftermarket modifications, clear blue-grey untinted windows. Each complete car including both wheels fully inside central 80% of its cell. Front-left three-quarter shot, nose points LEFT closest camera, body extends RIGHT; consistent angle and car scale, natural bright soft daylight, authentic realistic paint reflections. Distinct accurate models, in strict row-major order:
Row1: 1994 Toyota Mark II X90 sedan; 1997 Toyota Chaser Tourer V JZX100 sedan; 1996 Toyota Supra RZ A80 coupe; 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 coupe.
Row2: 1994 Mazda RX-7 FD coupe; 2000 Nissan Silvia S15 Varietta convertible with hardtop CLOSED; 1999 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI sedan; 1990 BMW M3 E30 coupe.
Row3: 2008 BMW 5 Series E60 sedan; 2014 Mercedes-Benz E-Class W212 facelift sedan; 1996 Mercedes-Benz E-Class W210 sedan; 2018 Mercedes-Benz C-Class W205 facelift sedan.
Critical: silver stock cars, authentic body shapes, 4 columns and 3 rows EXACTLY, no clipped vehicle or wheel. Separate full photo in every cell.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE production texture atlas for a car game, strict uniform 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 photorealistic car photographs, thin clean white dividers, equal rectangular cells. Maximum practical resolution 3072x2048 or larger landscape. No captions, text, numbers or watermark. Every car neutral factory SILVER paint, factory wheels and stock bodywork, untinted blue-grey windows. Beautiful bright Moscow central streets, stone embankments and landscaped avenues with distant Moscow City and elegant architecture, natural soft daytime lighting. Each entire car, both wheels and bumpers comfortably inside central 80% of cell. Front-left three-quarter view with nose facing LEFT closer camera and body extending RIGHT. Accurate authentic distinct model shapes. Exact row-major order:
Row1: 2009 Lexus IS F sedan; 1995 Nissan Silvia S14 coupe; 2022 Honda NSX Type S coupe; 2006 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR sedan.
Row2: 2022 Porsche 911 GT3 992 coupe; 2008 Mercedes-Benz CLS 63 AMG C219 sedan; 1998 Toyota Caldina GT-T ST215 station wagon; 2019 Bugatti Chiron Sport coupe.
Row3: 1999 Nissan Laurel C35 sedan; 2006 Mazda RX-8 coupe; 2022 BMW M3 Competition G80 sedan; 2020 BMW 330i G20 sedan.
Row4: 2022 Mercedes-AMG G 63 W463 SUV; 2021 BMW X6 M Competition F96 SUV coupe; 2006 Subaru Impreza WRX STI hawkeye sedan; 2007 Subaru Legacy B4 BL sedan.
Strict 4x4 grid, SILVER cars, realistic street photos, zero tuning modifications, full vehicles never cut off.
maskPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached production car photo texture atlas. Create an EXACTLY registered semantic segmentation texture of this exact image. Preserve canvas aspect ratio, exact grid, exact pixel positions and silhouettes of all vehicles. Do NOT redraw, recompose, move, enlarge or change any shape. Output a flat BLACK background with THREE solid clean channel colours only, no photographic texture, shadows or grey: pure RED (#ff0000) ONLY the painted metal body panels of every vehicle (entire hood, roof, pillars, fenders, doors, boot, painted bumper parts, mirrors), pure GREEN (#00ff00) ONLY glass windows and windshields of every vehicle, pure BLUE (#0000ff) ONLY alloy wheel rims (not tyres). EVERYTHING ELSE pure BLACK including sky buildings road trees grille headlights lamps chrome trim tyres shadows dividers. Accurately trace every contour and aperture of all model-specific body panels using the input as exact tracing template. No text, no white, no labels, no antialiased glows. Wheel rim ellipses must align exactly with the original. Entire panel has exactly same coordinate layout as original. This is a precise technical mask texture, not a creative illustration. Be meticulous with outlines. Generate at EXACT same original image dimensions if possible.
